task: Introduce a single MCP link predicate, links-only save validation, disable-and-report restore with in-place workflow YAML editing, and close two validation gaps in MCPAccessControlService and its callers.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches MCPAccessControlService, workflow and assistant version services, WorkflowService, workflow generator, sub-assistant router, preconfigured scripts, and adds a new YAML in-place editor and node-scoped collector (new abstractions).

No precedent for text-preserving YAML editing (only a read-only yaml.compose in line_lookup.py); flow style, anchors and merge keys are enumerated edge cases with no existing test template; new reason exposure channel against the deliberately generic refusal message; rollback must keep derived columns consistent. No project examples to calibrate against.
About 10-12 source files plus new editor module, response-model changes, OpenAPI snapshot baseline, and test updates (including one test that encodes the changed behaviour).
Service, REST API (rollback response additive field), persistence (yaml_config and history rewrite on restore), and deployment-time scripts; no schema migration.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: enumerated YAML edge cases (flow, anchors, merge keys) with no covering test template, plus no precedent for the editor
Component Scope: touches multiple workflows/save paths and a core shared service
